headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 20, 2026**
article:
The Cincinnati Reds secured a 9-4 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Sal Stewart leading the offense. Stewart hit a home run (12) on a fly ball to left field, scoring JJ Bleday. The Tampa Bay Rays took down the Baltimore Orioles in a 5-3 thriller, with Jesse Scholtens earning the win and Ian Seymour notching the save. The Minnesota Twins secured a 4-1 victory over the Houston Astros, with Joe Ryan earning the win after 6.0 innings of work, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups and rotations. The Atlanta Braves transferred Hurston Waldrep from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow surgery. The Colorado Rockies placed Victor Vodnik on the 15-day injured list with right ulnar nerve inflammation. The Tampa Bay Rays placed Ben Williamson on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 17, 2026, due to a low back strain. The Houston Astros placed Lance McCullers Jr. on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 16, 2026, with right shoulder inflammation.

Several teams made notable roster moves. The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley. The Tampa Bay Rays traded LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn. The Toronto Blue Jays traded LHP Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash. The Athletics traded CF Junior Perez to the Chicago White Sox for LHP Jackson Nove.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Phillies 9-4**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 9-4 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Sal Stewart leading the offense. Stewart hit a home run (12) on a fly ball to left field, scoring JJ Bleday.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Orioles in Thrilling 5-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 5-3 win over the Baltimore Orioles, with Jesse Scholtens earning the win and Ian Seymour notching the save.

top_news.title: **Astros Fall to Twins in 4-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 4-1 victory over the Houston Astros, with Joe Ryan earning the win after 6.0 innings of work, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run. Ryan Kreidler led the Astros' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rangers Edge Rockies in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a 5-4 victory over the Colorado Rockies, with Jacob Latz earning the win after pitching 2.0 innings with 4 strikeouts and no earned runs. Ezequiel Duran led the Rangers' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Guardians Take Down Tigers 3-1**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Patrick Bailey, Brayan Rocchio, and Dillon Dingler making significant contributions at the plate. Joey Cantillo was instrumental in the win, leading the Guardians' pitching effort.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Cardinals 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-2 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Brandon Lowe and Marcell Ozuna leading the charge for the winning team. Impact performances also came from Henry Davis and Alec Burleson, while Braxton Ashcraft and Dustin May stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Braves RHP Hurston Waldrep Undergoes Elbow Surgery**
top_news.summary: Atlanta Braves right-handed pitcher Hurston Waldrep has been transferred to the 60-day injured list after undergoing right elbow surgery.

top_news.title: **Reds Acquire Right-Hander in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Zach McCambley in a trade. McCambley joins the Reds after being dealt from the Miami Marlins.
